method: Actual MP3 bytes decoded with ffmpeg and transcribed with sherpa-onnx multilingual Whisper tiny/base/small int8 (Arabic). A canonical source requires an exact normalized Bismillah-only small or base transcript and no istiadhah in any reviewed transcript. Same-reciter source identity and SHA-256 are retained. Source selection does not depend on a destination-surah whitelist.
